summary: Bain Capital Private Credit, a Delaware BDC, on October 1, 2026 priced a $350 million private placement of 7.600% senior notes due October 8, 2031, sold under Rule 144A and Regulation S. Notes are redeemable at the Company's option before September 8, 2031 at par plus make-whole, thereafter at par. Closing is expected October 8, 2026, subject to customary conditions. Proceeds fund general corporate purposes and/or repay revolving credit facility borrowings, and may support portfolio investments. This is a routine debt capital raise, not a special situation; no board recommendation or advisor named. Watch spread and leverage metrics.
